scenes.text: This is {VGI|V-G-I}, the Vector Gateway Interface. [[tagline]]It lets you extend {DuckDB|Duck D-B} and Haybarn with functions, tables and catalogs, written in plain Python.

Extending {DuckDB|Duck D-B} normally means a C extension. [[a1]]Vectors and validity masks, [[a2]]string layouts, [[a3]]manual memory, [[a4]]a pinned binary interface. [[matrix]]And every {DuckDB|Duck D-B} release, you rebuild and ship it again, for every platform, [[rebuild]]even when your code didn't change.

{VGI|V-G-I} runs your function in its own process. [[pipe]]{DuckDB|Duck D-B} streams Arrow record batches to it, [[t1]]over {standard I/O|standard I-O}, [[t2]]sockets, [[t3]]shared memory, [[t4]]or the web. [[crash]]If the worker crashes, [[survive]]{DuckDB|Duck D-B} keeps running.

A worker is ordinary Python. [[types]]The type hints become the SQL signature, [[column]]and compute gets a whole column at once. [[attach]]Attach it from {DuckDB|Duck D-B}, [[query]]and call it like any built-in function.

Isn't crossing the process boundary slow? [[laneA]]Not when you send batches instead of rows. [[laneB]]One round trip carries {2,048|two thousand and forty-eight} rows. [[c1]]{DuckDB|Duck D-B} and the worker speak Arrow {IPC|I-P-C}, so batches cross without conversion, and on one machine, [[shm]]shared memory moves them with zero copies. [[c2]]Pushdown means less comes back. [[c3]]That's around {450 million|four hundred and fifty million} rows a second.
It scales out, too. [[threads]]{DuckDB|Duck D-B} splits a query across threads, [[fan]]and {VGI|V-G-I} matches it with several worker processes, [[flow]]each streaming its own batches in parallel.
Pick from five shapes: [[s1]]scalar, [[s2]]table, [[s3]]{table-in-out|table in out}, [[s4]]aggregate, [[s5]]and buffering. [[plus]]Plus COPY formats, writable tables and global functions.

A worker can be a whole catalog. [[query]]Attach it, and query it like any database. [[proj]]Columns, [[filter]]filters, [[topn]]and limits are pushed down to the worker. [[features]]Serve it over the web with auth, and trace it with {OpenTelemetry|Open Telemetry} and Sentry.
Install {vgi-python|V-G-I python}, and start building. [[langs]]There are also {SDKs|S-D-Ks} for Go, TypeScript, Rust, Java and {C#|C sharp}. [[brand]]Docs are at {query.farm|query dot farm}.
